title: Seeing, Listening, Remembering, and Reasoning: A Multimodal Agent with Long-Term Memory
problem: Multimodal agents struggle to accumulate consistent world knowledge and reason over indefinitely long perceptual streams.
assumption_broken: Long-term memory need not be a finite video description retrieved in a single turn.
operational_signature: Observe → extract → link → retrieve → reason
load_bearing_mechanism: Entity-centric episodic and semantic memories support reinforcement-learned iterative retrieval and reasoning.
limitations_evident: Robot-perspective videos use human actors rather than deployed robots
Semantic memory attention remains limited
Visual memory richness and efficiency need improvement

title: Memento: Fine-tuning LLM Agents without Fine-tuning LLMs
problem: Continual agent adaptation is constrained by rigid workflows or costly LLM weight updates.
assumption_broken: Policy improvement can occur through case-memory updates while the underlying LLM stays frozen.
operational_signature: Retrieve → adapt → execute → evaluate → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: A growing bank of successful and failed trajectories guides planning through case-based retrieval, optionally learned by soft Q-learning.

improver_modified.how: The parametric variant updates the case-retrieval Q-function through temporal-difference learning.

limitations_evident: Long-horizon Level 3 tasks remain challenging
Additional retrieved cases can introduce noise
Validation headline uses repeated memory-building passes

title: SEFRQO: A Self-Evolving Fine-Tuned RAG-Based Query Optimizer
problem: Learned query optimizers face cold starts and costly retraining when workloads change.
assumption_broken: Runtime improvement need not require repeatedly fine-tuning an optimizer's model weights.
operational_signature: Retrieve → propose → execute → record → refine
load_bearing_mechanism: Execution records from similar queries and prior attempts dynamically condition a fine-tuned hint generator.
limitations_evident: Inference overhead limits applicability to OLAP rather than OLTP
Online evaluations repeatedly optimize the same workload
Some LLM optimizer baselines could not be reproduced

title: Building Self-Evolving Agents via Experience-Driven Lifelong Learning: A Framework and Benchmark
problem: Static isolated-task agents fail to accumulate knowledge and reusable skills across long interdependent experiences.
assumption_broken: Agent learning need not assume fixed datasets, predefined task boundaries, or exclusively parameter-level updates.
operational_signature: Explore → reflect → consolidate → abstract → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Structured reflection converts interaction trajectories into persistent memories and reusable procedural lessons.
limitations_evident: Simulated college environment rather than real-world deployment
Current agents lack self-motivation and robust long-term memory
Framework ambitions exceed the evaluation details supplied

title: Learning Game-Playing Agents with Generative Code Optimization
problem: Deep reinforcement learning requires many interactions and produces opaque policies for long-horizon gameplay.
assumption_broken: Sequential decision policies can be optimized as readable Python programs rather than neural weights.
operational_signature: Execute → trace → diagnose → rewrite → reevaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: OptoPrime rewrites modular policy code using execution traces and staged feedback from longer gameplay evaluations.
limitations_evident: Game-specific scaffolds and staged human strategies
Context limits force short traced rollouts
LLM edits can destabilize policies

title: Memory-R1: Enhancing Large Language Model Agents to Manage and Utilize Memories via Reinforcement Learning
problem: Heuristic memory operations and unfiltered retrieval impair long-context dialogue reasoning.
assumption_broken: Memory editing and filtering policies can be learned from downstream answer outcomes without operation-level labels.
operational_signature: Extract → retrieve → edit → filter → answer → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: Outcome-based PPO or GRPO trains memory operations and answer-time memory distillation with exact-match rewards.

improver_modified.how: The Memory Manager that writes external memories is itself fine-tuned using downstream QA rewards.

limitations_evident: Dialogue-only evaluation
Separately trained agents complicate coordination
Adversarial questions excluded from LoCoMo evaluation

title: Middo: Model-Informed Dynamic Data Optimization for Enhanced LLM Fine-Tuning via Closed-Loop Learning
problem: Static data filtering and synthesis fail to track changing model learning needs.
assumption_broken: Training examples can be repeatedly repaired in response to the learner rather than curated once and held fixed.
operational_signature: Diagnose → select → rewrite → train → rediagnose
load_bearing_mechanism: Loss, embedding sparsity, and self-alignment jointly identify examples for context-preserving refinement.

improver_modified.how: The learner supplying loss, embeddings, and quality scores is retrained on each refined dataset.

limitations_evident: Diagnostics require a sufficiently capable learner
Repeated retraining and synthesis increase cost
Initial data biases may propagate

title: ArcMemo: Abstract Reasoning Composition with Lifelong LLM Memory
problem: Reasoning discoveries are discarded between queries or stored as overly specific examples that transfer poorly.
assumption_broken: Reusable reasoning memory can consist of modular abstract concepts rather than complete solution instances.
operational_signature: Solve → verify → abstract → store → select → compose
load_bearing_mechanism: Parameterized concept memories distilled from verified solution traces enable selective retrieval and recombination.
limitations_evident: Requires feedback to avoid storing flawed concepts
Evaluation covers 100 public ARC puzzles
Selection can omit useful concepts and introduce distractors

title: Code2MCP: Transforming Code Repositories into MCP Services
problem: The MCP ecosystem lacks an automated supply of reliable tools derived from existing repositories.
assumption_broken: Agent-ready tool pools can be generated and repaired automatically rather than assumed to exist.
operational_signature: Analyze → wrap → execute → diagnose → repair → package
load_bearing_mechanism: A multi-agent Run-Review-Fix loop uses execution tracebacks to repair generated MCP adapters.
limitations_evident: Environment reconstruction and interface inference dominate failures
Script-driven and interactive repositories remain difficult
Adversarial repositories are not evaluated

title: SEDM: Selective Self-Evolving Distributed Memory for Agents
problem: Indiscriminate sharing and injection of agent memories increases cost and can reduce success.
assumption_broken: Relevant or previously useful memory should not automatically be retained or used for every recipient.
operational_signature: Replay → admit → rank → abstract → calibrate → gate
load_bearing_mechanism: Paired outcomes estimate memory utility for admission and train a calibrated gate that weighs expected success gains against context cost.

improver_modified.how: The recipient memory gate is trained on paired outcomes and calibrated on a separate split.

limitations_evident: Original headline admission tests memories on their source tasks
Gate tests use frozen memory and one agent backbone
Held-out LoCoMo test contains only one conversation

title: Learning to Optimize Multi-Objective Alignment Through Dynamic Reward Weighting
problem: Fixed reward scalarization wastes training effort and misses non-convex multi-objective trade-offs.
assumption_broken: Reward weights can evolve during alignment rather than remain fixed preference constants.
operational_signature: Measure → estimate influence → reweight → update → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Hypervolume contributions or cross-objective gradient influence dynamically redirect learning toward improvable objectives.

improver_modified.how: Reward weights controlling subsequent policy updates are adapted using hypervolume or gradient feedback.

limitations_evident: Irreducible objective conflicts limit gains
Hypervolume meta-rewards need calibration
Gradient method relaxes clipping and KL safeguards to preserve linearity

title: PRINCIPLES: Synthetic Strategy Memory for Proactive Dialogue Agents
problem: Proactive dialogue planners have limited strategy coverage, preference bias, and expensive training requirements.
assumption_broken: Strategy knowledge can be elicited into reusable contrasting principles rather than learned through additional parameter updates.
operational_signature: Simulate → score → backtrack → revise → distill → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful and repaired failed self-play turns yield situation-specific principles contrasting effective and ineffective strategies.
limitations_evident: Embedding retrieval misses nuanced situations
Turn-level reward lacks explicit long-term goals
Simulation-derived emotional support strategies lack expert validation

title: ShinkaEvolve: Towards Open-Ended And Sample-Efficient Program Evolution
problem: LLM program evolution wastes evaluations on redundant mutations and inefficient exploration.
assumption_broken: Mutation-model choice and archive sampling need not remain static during program search.
operational_signature: Sample → mutate → reject redundancy → execute → archive → adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: Novelty filtering, exploration-aware parent sampling, and improvement-based bandit model selection make evolution sample-efficient.

improver_modified.how: Observed mutation gains update LLM sampling probabilities and periodic meta-scratchpad guidance.

limitations_evident: Requires human-defined numerical objectives and evaluators
Exploration settings remain partly fixed
API costs remain a barrier

title: SGMem: Sentence Graph Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents
problem: Fragmented dialogue history and generated memories hinder coherent long-term retrieval.
assumption_broken: Conversational memory graphs need not rely on costly extracted entity-relation triples or coarse chunks alone.
operational_signature: Segment → embed → link → retrieve → expand → integrate
load_bearing_mechanism: Sentence-level similarity graphs recover coherent parent chunks and combine them with generated memory.
limitations_evident: Generated memories may contain unverified hallucinations
No streaming or multimodal evaluation
Large-scale graph maintenance overhead is unoptimized

title: SPELL: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning for Evolving Long-Context Language Models
problem: Long-context reasoning lacks scalable reliable annotations and programmatically verifiable rewards.
assumption_broken: One evolving policy can jointly generate tasks, solve them, and supply semantic verification rather than depend on fixed external supervision.
operational_signature: Generate → ground → solve → verify → balance → update
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint GRPO across questioner, responder, and verifier maintains a competence-matched curriculum with semantic consensus rewards.

improver_modified.how: Shared-policy updates improve the question generator and semantic verifier alongside the responder.

limitations_evident: Consensus can preserve shared verification errors
Role imbalance requires specialized sampling
Training uses a 16K context ceiling

title: MemGen: Weaving Generative Latent Memory for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: External retrieval is rigid and full-model experiential tuning risks catastrophic forgetting.
assumption_broken: Memory can be generated as latent tokens during reasoning rather than retrieved once or embedded in updated core weights.
operational_signature: Monitor → trigger → synthesize → insert → continue → reinforce
load_bearing_mechanism: Separately trained trigger and weaver adapters insert state-conditioned latent memories into a frozen reasoner.

improver_modified.how: Training updates the memory-generating weaver and the policy deciding when to invoke it while freezing the core reasoner.

limitations_evident: Latent memories are not human-readable
Adapter training remains necessary
Memory invocation introduces inference overhead

title: Socratic-Zero : Bootstrapping Reasoning via Data-Free Agent Co-evolution
problem: Static synthetic reasoning datasets cannot adapt to solver weaknesses or maintain useful curriculum difficulty.
assumption_broken: A learned curriculum generator can evolve with a solver rather than rely on a frozen synthetic corpus.
operational_signature: Attempt → judge → expose weakness → refine tasks → distill → retrain
load_bearing_mechanism: Teacher-verified preference learning improves the solver while utility-weighted distillation trains a generator near its competence frontier.

improver_modified.how: The Generator learns the fixed Teacher's failure-targeted question refinement strategy through value-weighted fine-tuning.

limitations_evident: Data-free framing still requires 100 seeds and 1,500 SFT initialization problems
Relies on a large fixed teacher
Generated-problem counts are internally inconsistent

title: LatentEvolve: Self-Evolving Test-Time Scaling in Latent Space
problem: Independent test-time reasoning runs discard optimization experience instead of improving future scaling.
assumption_broken: Inference-time adaptation can accumulate reusable optimization trajectories without changing the core LLM.
operational_signature: Retrieve → transfer momentum → refine → archive → consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Retrieved latent optimization deltas initialize new reasoning, while a learned weaver periodically consolidates high-confidence traces.

improver_modified.how: Nighttime training updates the latent weaver that initializes subsequent daytime optimization.

limitations_evident: Self-rewards can mistake confidence for correctness
Latent refinement requires repeated sampled generations
Benchmarks are adapted on their own test streams

title: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory
problem: Persistent agents repeat errors because past interactions are discarded or preserved only as low-level success routines.
assumption_broken: Failed trajectories and contrastive exploration can produce reusable strategy memory without ground-truth labels.
operational_signature: Retrieve → explore → self-judge → contrast → distill → accumulate
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-judged successes and failures are abstracted into strategy memories, with scaled exploration enriching contrastive extraction.
limitations_evident: Self-judgment supplies imperfect correctness proxies
Memory consolidation simply appends entries
Additional exploration raises per-task compute

title: Mem-α: Learning Memory Construction via Reinforcement Learning
problem: Untuned agents fail to select and organize useful information in complex multi-component memories.
assumption_broken: Memory-write policies can be learned directly from downstream utility rather than prescribed by instructions.
operational_signature: Read chunk → write → retrieve → answer → reward → update
load_bearing_mechanism: GRPO trains structured memory construction using downstream QA accuracy plus execution, semantic-validity, and compression rewards.

improver_modified.how: The memory-writing policy is reinforced while retrieval and answer generation stay frozen.

limitations_evident: Conflict resolution evaluation is excluded
Training requires 32 H100 GPUs for three days
Production latency, safety, and database integration remain untested

title: AgenticEval: Toward Agentic and Self-Evolving Safety Evaluation of Large Language Models
problem: Static safety benchmarks lag evolving risks and fail to operationalize complex regulations.
assumption_broken: Safety evaluation can adapt its tests to target-specific failure modes instead of remaining a one-time fixed audit.
operational_signature: Structure rules → ground → generate → evaluate → diagnose → retarget
load_bearing_mechanism: An analyst converts rubric-judged model failures into directives for progressively targeted test generation.
limitations_evident: Policy interpretation is not legal certification
LLM judge hallucinations and capability mismatches may misclassify responses
Adaptive testing increases cost and latency

title: Your Agent May Misevolve: Emergent Risks in Self-evolving LLM Agents
problem: Task-driven self-evolution can degrade alignment and introduce vulnerabilities unnoticed by static safety assessments.
assumption_broken: Improving task utility does not imply that evolving agent components remain safe.
operational_signature: Evolve → probe safety → track drift → diagnose → mitigate
load_bearing_mechanism: Longitudinal and before-after safety audits expose risks across parameter, memory, tool, and workflow evolution.
limitations_evident: Mitigations only partly restore initial safety
Proposed static tool verification is not tested
Different pathways use different systems and benchmarks

title: Improving Code Localization with Repository Memory
problem: Localization agents waste effort rediscovering repository knowledge for every issue.
assumption_broken: A bug localization task need not start without prior knowledge of repository evolution.
operational_signature: Collect history → summarize hotspots → retrieve precedent → inspect → localize
load_bearing_mechanism: Historical commits and summaries of frequently edited files provide complementary priors for graph-based localization.
limitations_evident: Sparse or irrelevant histories can distract and degrade performance
Average cost increases and varies sharply per issue
Evaluation targets file localization rather than completed fixes

title: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models
problem: Repeated context rewriting discards useful domain detail and collapses accumulated agent knowledge.
assumption_broken: Adapted contexts need not be concise monolithic summaries; detailed playbooks can grow incrementally.
operational_signature: Generate → reflect → curate deltas → merge → refine → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Localized structured delta updates preserve prior strategies while adding new lessons without monolithic rewriting.
limitations_evident: Requires a sufficiently capable reflector
Detailed contexts can be redundant for simple tasks
Online results adapt sequentially on test samples

title: CAM: A Constructivist View of Agentic Memory for LLM-Based Reading Comprehension
problem: Long-text memory systems struggle to preserve associations while efficiently incorporating newly arriving document batches.
assumption_broken: Memory hierarchies need not force exclusive membership or require global reconstruction after updates.
operational_signature: Connect → disentangle → cluster incrementally → summarize → prune and grow → respond
load_bearing_mechanism: Local-first incremental overlapping clustering updates only affected hierarchical abstractions while allowing chunks to support multiple summaries.
limitations_evident: Hierarchical summaries can propagate hallucinations
Assumes internally consistent sources
Fixed prompts and hyperparameters do not learn from downstream feedback

title: Scientific Algorithm Discovery by Augmenting AlphaEvolve with Deep Research
problem: Algorithm evolution plateaus when proposals rely only on internal model knowledge, while untested research ideas often cannot be implemented.
assumption_broken: Scientific code evolution need not operate without external research or restrict mutations to a single file.
operational_signature: Research → propose → edit → debug → evaluate → archive → sample
load_bearing_mechanism: Feedback-grounded deep research supplies implementable hypotheses to multi-file evolution with automatic debugging.
limitations_evident: Repeated selection uses supplied evaluation scores with unclear held-out separation
Training-heavy proposals often exceed runtime limits
Gains depend strongly on initial algorithm maturity

title: Training-Free Group Relative Policy Optimization
problem: Specialized agent adaptation through parameter tuning is expensive and data hungry.
assumption_broken: Group-relative policy improvement need not change weights; experience expressed as context can steer a frozen model.
operational_signature: Sample groups → score → contrast → distill → edit experience → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Comparing rewarded winners and losers yields semantic advantages that update an external experience library.
limitations_evident: Main comparisons use different model sizes and training budgets
Repeated inference runs are reported without clear variance estimates
Default semantic advantages require groups containing both winners and losers

title: Evolution in Simulation: AI-Agent School with Dual Memory for High-Fidelity Educational Dynamics
problem: Educational simulations lack realistic evolving role behavior and coherent models of teacher-student interactions.
assumption_broken: Role behavior need not remain fixed; interaction-derived experience and knowledge can refine it over time.
operational_signature: Interact → reflect → separate experience and knowledge → prioritize → retrieve → adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate experience and knowledge stores with salient short-term subsets support reflection and role-consistent reuse.
limitations_evident: Only 50 agents over five simulated days
Evaluation and evolution rely on one expert-curated scenario set
Text-only agents cannot model visual or nonverbal cues

title: EvoTest: Evolutionary Test-Time Learning for Self-Improving Agentic Systems
problem: Agents struggle to improve from a few repeated attempts at sparse-reward long-horizon tasks.
assumption_broken: Test-time adaptation need not be limited to memory, prompts, or parameter updates in isolation.
operational_signature: Act → analyze transcript → mutate configuration → select by confidence → retry
load_bearing_mechanism: Whole-system configuration evolution converts narrative feedback into coordinated behavioral changes selected by UCB.
limitations_evident: Learns on identical resets of the same six games rather than unseen task transfer
Weight-update baselines use a different backbone
Equal action budgets do not establish equal adaptation compute

title: MemoTime: Memory-Augmented Temporal Knowledge Graph Enhanced Large Language Model Reasoning
problem: Temporal QA pipelines violate time constraints and repeatedly reconstruct reasoning strategies across related questions.
assumption_broken: Temporal retrieval and decomposition need not be static or discard previously verified reasoning experience.
operational_signature: Ground → decompose → recall → retrieve under constraints → verify → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Operator-aware hierarchical reasoning reuses verified experience while enforcing shared temporal constraints on retrieved paths.
limitations_evident: Memory construction and test-stream separation are not specified in supplied text
Requires structured temporal knowledge graphs
Verification relies on LLM judgments and voting
